purpose: Teacher-authorized student-specific Portfolio report delivery using the private Drive archive; no grading or evidence decisions occur here.

source.staff_directory: not required when support_contacts contains staff_email; never infer missing addresses

prepare_email_reports.rule: Read Latest Portfolio Results.zip, validate results_manifest.json, convert each active individual self-contained HTML report to PDF, write/replace current PDFs in 03 Student Packets/Email Delivery, and rebuild email_delivery_manifest.csv. Do not regrade, reread evidence, or modify Portfolio grades.

preflight.custom_note_field: Visible blank optional field per student on every successful `Refresh Reports & Load Class`. A note is temporary current-review state only; it is cleaned/saved by `Save Changes & Recheck` so the exact reviewed note can be tested or sent.
preflight.weekly_note: optional class-wide note; never hardcode dates/events
preflight.support_staff_default: include active support staff with valid email addresses when available; display exact staff name, role, support class when present, and email in preflight
preflight.blocked_rows: may be excluded by teacher checkbox; excluded rows do not block the rest of the send
preflight.left_checkbox: Send checkbox appears left of student name; uncheck to omit this send only.
preflight.custom_note_polish: Teacher-entered note fragments are cleaned deterministically and use the student first name instead of guessing gendered pronouns. A new successful `Refresh Reports & Load Class` clears all student custom-note rows so every student field starts blank.
preflight.roster_action: The email tool does not remove students from the class. Use the Portfolio roster-update workflow for roster changes; uncheck Send for a temporary omission.
preflight.mastery_goal_grade_columns: Show four compact read-only columns MG1-MG4 from 02 Portfolio Data/mastery_goal_status_current.csv. Assessed goals show grade_code; unassessed goals show `NA` in this email-review table only; missing state shows an em dash and is never invented.

recipients.privacy: Use BCC for non-student recipients. Deduplicate all addresses. Never share a Drive report folder as a substitute for student-specific delivery.
recipients.support_roles: course-agnostic free text; do not restrict routing to a fixed role allowlist

family_language.not_assessed: We have not checked this Mastery Goal yet.
family_language.needs_first_check: We have not checked this skill yet.
family_language.powerschool: PowerSchool shows one current grade for each Mastery Goal once that goal has been assessed. Individual evidence sources are not separate grades averaged together.
family_language.weekly_note_rule: Only include teacher-entered weekly note text.
family_language.in_progress: An I means In Progress. It is not permanent. It reflects current evidence and can change as new or stronger evidence is added; earlier checks are not averaged in as permanent penalties.

safety.student_note_after_live_send: Delete the successfully sent student custom-note row entirely. A new successful class refresh also clears all student custom-note rows so fields start blank.

support_contact_schema.role_rule: Free text, course-agnostic. Common examples: Case Manager, Special Education Teacher, Study Skills Teacher, Academic Support Teacher, Resource Room Teacher.
support_contact_schema.support_class_rule: Optional free text for any support/resource/study-skills class; blank for relationships not tied to a class.
support_contact_schema.active_rule: Only truthy active rows with a valid staff_email are eligible recipients.
support_contact_schema.privacy_rule: Do not store disability, diagnosis, accommodation narrative, or other IEP details in this routing file.

identity_safety.hard_rule: Never send an attachment unless the prepared manifest explicitly records identity_verified=true for that student and the manifest student_name exactly matches the current recipient roster row.
identity_safety.html_prepare: Before HTML-to-PDF conversion, verify the individual HTML visibly contains the exact manifest student name.
identity_safety.pdf_prepare: A PDF path is accepted only when the results manifest explicitly marks identity_verified=true from a prior exact identity check.
identity_safety.stale_manifest: Legacy manifests without identity_verified are blocked and require `Refresh Reports & Load Class`.

ui_workflow.primary_refresh: One button, `Refresh Reports & Load Class`, prepares identity-verified reports, loads notes, and runs preflight in one visible busy sequence.
ui_workflow.edit_review: Teacher edits include checkboxes, weekly note, and student custom notes, then clicks `Save Changes & Recheck`; notes are cleaned/saved and preflight reruns.
ui_workflow.busy_feedback: Every multi-step action shows a visible spinner/progress message, states that a full refresh/live send may take a few minutes, asks the teacher to leave the tab open, and temporarily disables conflicting controls.
ui_workflow.test: `Send Test to Me` sends only the selected student message/attachment to the teacher.
ui_workflow.live_send_label: The live button must dynamically say `LIVE SEND — EMAIL <student_count> STUDENTS NOW` when ready; never use an ambiguous label such as `Send Included Reports`.
ui_workflow.live_send_warning: Immediately above/below the live button, state that it sends real emails to every checked READY student and BCCs listed guardians/support staff.
ui_workflow.live_confirmation: Before live send, show student-email count and total-recipient count and explicitly state `This is not a test.`
ui_workflow.dirty_state: Any Send checkbox, weekly note, student custom note, or support-staff change immediately disables both test and live-send controls until `Save Changes & Recheck` succeeds.
ui_workflow.roster_removal: No Remove from class control appears in the email interface. Roster maintenance belongs to the Portfolio roster workflow.
ui_workflow.mastery_goal_scan: Preflight table shows four compact read-only Mastery Goal grade columns (MG1-MG4). Use `NA` for unassessed goals in this compact email-review table.
ui_workflow.custom_note_position: Keep the Custom note field visible immediately after Student so it remains easy to find even when the review table scrolls horizontally.
